scope_note: This establishes an explicit disagreement boundary inside the joint work; it does not by itself adjudicate which author's later interpretation was better supported.
statement: In their 1895 preface, Breuer and Freud said that they agreed on the facts and their basic reading but sometimes differed in interpretation and conjecture.
statement_zh: Breuer 與 Freud 在 1895 年序言中表示：兩人同意事實及基本理解，但在詮釋與推測上有時並不一致。
